benchmark_title: Rippl Quantitative Invalidation Benchmark (FalkorDB vs Recursive SQL vs Flat Vector RAG)

recursive_sql.name: Recursive SQL CTE (SQLite 3)
recursive_sql.comparison_note: Both FalkorDB and Recursive SQL achieve 100% recall. On 113 nodes, raw execution time differences (sub-millisecond) are negligible. The architectural distinction is expressiveness: 1 line of Cypher vs. 15 lines of recursive union joins, plus FalkorDB's native sparse adjacency matrix storage.

vector_rag.name: Flat-Vector RAG (Cosine Top-5)
vector_rag.embedded_content: Node text descriptions (claim statement, decision policy text, action command description). Embeddings reflect semantic/lexical similarity.
vector_rag.why_recall_is_low: Vector similarity only retrieves nodes mentioning 'Shard-09' (CLM-001, DEC-001). Downstream regional policies (DEC-002) and billing commands (ACT-001, ACT-018) have zero semantic overlap with database lag metrics, causing silent agent failures.

baseline_footnote: Evaluated on 113 load-bearing nodes in FalkorDB. Ground truth blast radius computed via variable-length GraphBLAS BFS. Flat-Vector RAG retrieves solely via dense vector cosine similarity (top-5), which cannot traverse indirect causal links, resulting in silent agent execution failures.
